integrity: All infinite assertions are proved symbolically from the published construction. No finite experiment is used to infer a statement about the full spectrum or idempotent set.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the Tran–Nguyen ring. It does not classify spectra of all annihilator-condition rings or all function rings of the form Delta B plus finitely supported functions; a generic unindexed theorem about orthogonal-idempotent ideals could subsume part of the argument.
title: Prime spectrum and idempotents of the Tran–Nguyen counterexample ring
